title: feat(auth): extract build_credential_store to stoa-auth (option A)
description: Three separate build_credential_store implementations exist in imap/main.rs, reader/server_stores.rs, and smtp/server.rs. Option A chosen: add secretx as dep to stoa-auth and expose a shared async build_credential_store(users, credential_file) function. Cloud backends remain feature-gated. All three binaries call the shared function; local BuildStoreError private types are deleted. Closes stoa-44ba837b.1.
